div.div: TX-13 / Approve full refund and quarantine inventory

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 654px; height: 1px; padding-top: 218px; margin-left: 64px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.div:
GUARDS
Full actual charge only; voluntary policy cutoff saved on order; checked-in units must be
reviewed/reversed; authorized actor. Compensation can have no tickets.
LOCK / CONSISTENCY
Lock authorization, organization/event, order, allocations, payment/refund and tickets
under canonical hierarchy.
DATABASE WRITES
INSERT refund requested (unique payment_attempt_id); order -> refund_pending; tickets ->
refund_pending invalid; sold allocations -> refund_quarantine; INSERT audit and refund
outbox; COMMIT before provider call.
RELATIONSHIP EFFECT
All old links remain. Compensation refund on unfulfilled duplicate charge must NOT
invalidate the legitimate tickets fulfilled by a different attempt.
FAILURE / RETRY
Reject amount mismatch/second logical refund. Pending/failed/unknown refund never releases
stock. Once invalidated, do not silently restore old ticket on provider failure.

div.div: TX-14 / Dispatch/reconcile refund, confirm success, then release stock

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 654px; height: 1px; padding-top: 218px; margin-left: 804px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.div:
GUARDS
Provider result corresponds to same full-refund obligation/charge; request acceptance is
not final success.
LOCK / CONSISTENCY
Worker leases outside business TX; finalization locks organization/event,
order/allocation/payment/refund/ticket as applicable.
DATABASE WRITES
INSERT/UPDATE refund_attempt; uncertain -> reconcile, failed -> retain quarantine. Success:
refund succeeded/time; chosen fulfillment order -> refunded; tickets -> refunded;
quarantine allocations -> released/refund_succeeded; append finance entries/refund fee
reversal; notifications/audit/outbox; availability_version++.
RELATIONSHIP EFFECT
Unique refund per charge and finance source-kind keys prevent duplicate financial/release
effects. Replacement purchase uses NEW hold/allocation/order_item/ticket referencing the
same event_seat.
FAILURE / RETRY
Timeout must not start a different logical refund. If callback replay after success, no
additional release. Cancelled/closed/suspended event inventory remains unpurchasable
despite allocation release.

div.div: TX-15 / Cancel free registration or cancel event

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 654px; height: 1px; padding-top: 698px; margin-left: 64px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.div:
GUARDS
Free-order owner policy/authorized staff, or organizer cancellation permission. Event
cancellation overrides ordinary voluntary-refund eligibility.
LOCK / CONSISTENCY
Lock organization/event; operate orders/allocations/tickets in stable order. For large
event, close event gate first then durable bounded per-order jobs.
DATABASE WRITES
Free order: tickets cancelled, sold allocations released/free_cancel, order cancelled,
audit. Event: event cancelled, calendar_sequence/version++, audit and cancellation jobs;
workers invalidate/cancel tickets and initiate paid refunds via TX-13.
RELATIONSHIP EFFECT
The event gate makes every ticket immediately ineffective even if per-ticket
materialization is still queued. Historical FKs and accepted check-ins remain.
FAILURE / RETRY
Cancellation job retries must resume without duplicate refunds. Pending payments that later
succeed compensate, never fulfill. Refund completion cannot republish cancelled event.

div.div: TX-16 / Activate paid sales and suspend/reinstate activation

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 654px; height: 1px; padding-top: 755px; margin-left: 804px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.div:
GUARDS
Same-event terms, same-org verified payout and approved identity; at least one paid type;
exact activation fee success. Platform admin for suspension.
LOCK / CONSISTENCY
Lock organization/event, activation/intent/attempt and referenced checklist rows.
DATABASE WRITES
INSERT terms_acceptance, verification_record, payout_profile as needed; sales_activation
incomplete->pending->active; choose one paid_attempt_id; append activation fee finance
entry/audit. Suspension sets status/reason, never deletes payment.
RELATIONSHIP EFFECT
payment_intent targets activation exclusively; chosen paid attempt must refer to this
activation intent (TX guard beyond same-event FK). Duplicated event starts without these
relations.
FAILURE / RETRY
Incomplete checklist cannot activate. Duplicate external activation charge is retained and
compensated; original legitimate activation remains intact. Simulated identity never
presented as production KYC.
